understanding.goal_understanding: The goal was to move every selectable piece onto a goal tile marked '+'. A level is won only when all goal tiles are simultaneously occupied by pieces.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: Pieces are selected and moved by clicking positions on the grid. Movement is constrained by walls and obstacles; clicks into blocked or inaccessible locations have no effect but still consume a step. Pieces can move through open spaces, and pushing/interaction with obstacles must follow the grid's movement rules. Only the currently selected piece responds to clicks, so pieces must be positioned deliberately and efficiently within the step limit.
